text: Baregodu tabo ure tugerago ji, ure reko tuwai kae .
Boekimorabodo u(radu)re barae corewuge towuje .
Ca pugeje ure nowu tubemo to moto to pugeje .
Ure ekerogu towuje: aroe , pejo, ju , kuiada , banana.
Awu enogwagere jiboe ji, ure maku etae.
Nono makore tuwo jugorewu towuje .
Nono ure nowu tubemo to moto to pugeje ca baregodu tabo .
Oreduje pegarogu jetadure .
Ca makore nowu amugudo aruduwo boe ji:
Boe pegagodugodunure nono ure tumugudo aiwore: boekimorabodu, tapira, jugorewu, kagariga.
Awu barae enogwagere jiboe boe rabodu ure towuje .
Ca boecodure pugeje rore oino pugeje .
Nono ure nowu kobo boe towuje .
Ca makore ca itumode tabiji .
Ca nono uture pugeje toro boe kajeje , ure iage towuje pugeje .
Ca ure awu pabadui pume kejedu boe towuje .
Ure barae , boe , boe pegarewuge , ure boejamedu boe towuje du .
Tabore mugure ure to nowu tubemo tabo ure padowuje.
Mare pagi nowu ako oino iwiagaiwudo akore: pagire paro oino, mare ure oino rugadu pagi rugadu.
Awu meri ji vinte e sete de janeiro de dois mil e vinte e seis.
Ure okeagi caci , ca , kare akore ica !
Co?! Aerudure cowu boe ji?! Iorudu kodo nono duji .
Nessa ocasião tinha naquela aldeia 3 homens Cerae e 3 Tugarege: Cerae: Tiago, Coqueiro, Vito.
